title: refactor(components)!: retire 44 more zero-consumer entry exports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuJXTeAARtJsGhaLjuKz6yHL)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is barrel batch 7, claim 6674577823 (seat `domain:ui#1`), batch amendments 6674785161 and 6674939838. Earlier batches: #30541, #30576, #30629, #30650, #30708, #30752.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/components` 的包入口再少导出 44 个名字。其中 13 个包内也无人读，直接删除（`item.tsx` 的 9 个子件、整个 `native-select.tsx`、`ResizableHandleProps`、`useRelatedCount`）；其余 31 个只离开入口，留在原模块供本包渲染器、筛选器和通知组件使用。
- 为什么改：这 44 个名字在仓内（包外，含测试与文档）与 hotcrm 均零引用或只有同名异物，README 未教，也不被保留导出的签名用到。本卡逐包收窄无人使用的公开导出。
- 风险与回滚：对外是 breaking 收窄，只影响直接从包入口 import 这些名字的外部宿主；控制台、所有 `@object-ui/*` 包、所有 schema 节点类型、筛选器和五种通知照常。`custom/index.ts` 的 8 行 `export *` 改成具名列表，反向探针证明其余 364 个入口名一个不少。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/custom/index.ts`（具名列表，漏列即丢活名）、`src/custom/item.tsx`（删掉 9 个子件）、`.changeset/25921-components-helpers-and-family-heads.md`（迁移说明）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -l -w -e ItemMedia -e NativeSelect -e notificationSeverityStyle -- ':!ui/packages/components' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 应只命中本 PR 的 changeset。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/components`, **deleted** (nothing inside the package read them, tests included): the item sub-parts `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent`, `ItemActions`, `ItemGroup`, `ItemSeparator`, `ItemTitle`, `ItemDescription`, `ItemHeader`, `ItemFooter` (with the local `itemMediaVariants`; `Item` stays); `src/custom/native-select.tsx` with `NativeSelect` and `NativeSelectProps`; the type alias `ResizableHandleProps`; the hook `useRelatedCount` (one doc line that recommended it now points at `RelatedCountStore.get` under `useRelatedCountVersion()`). `item.tsx` is listed under `customComponents` in `shadcn-components.json` and `native-select.tsx` is not listed at all, so `pnpm shadcn:update` restores neither.
- `@object-ui/components`, **off the entry only** (module files untouched except the deletions above; the shadcn registry files under `src/ui/` are not edited):
  - `src/ui/index.ts`: `MenubarMenu`, `MenubarItem`, `NavigationMenuItem`, `InputOTPGroup`, `InputOTPSeparator`, `CarouselItem` (the batch-6 family heads, per the seat's ruling). `input-otp` and `navigation-menu` leave the entry entirely; `Menubar`, `Carousel` and `CarouselApi` stay (see Acceptance notes).
  - `src/custom/index.ts`: `export *` over `filter-builder`, `filterRecordCurrency`, `kbd`, `navigation-overlay`, `view-states`, `mobile-dialog-content` becomes named lists, `native-select` goes, the `record-list-face` list keeps only `ActiveListRecordProvider`. Off: `mountedOperatorValue`, `retypeFilterValue`, `narrowFilterValueToOptions`, `CURRENCY_COMPANION_SUFFIX`, `currencyCompanionId`, `currencyCompanionOf`, `pairedCurrencyField`, `KbdGroup`, `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_FALLBACK`, `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON_FALLBACK`, `DataLoadingState`, `DataLoadingStateProps`, `isInsidePopperLayer`, `usePopperAwareInteractOutside`, `useIsActiveListRecord`, `useScrollActiveListRecordIntoView`, `ActiveListRow`, `listRecordIdOf`. Each named list was built from the checker's export list of that module, so no name a module re-exports is lost.
  - `src/notifications/index.ts`: the `severity` block goes (`NOTIFICATION_ACTION_BUTTON_VARIANTS`, `NOTIFICATION_POSITION_CLASSES`, `NOTIFICATION_SEVERITY_STYLES`, `notificationActionVariant`, `notificationIcon`, `notificationSeverityStyle`, `NotificationSeverityStyle`); the four surfaces read it from the module file already.
- All in-package readers already import these names from their module files (`renderers/overlay/menubar.tsx`, `renderers/basic/navigation-menu.tsx`, `renderers/form/input-otp.tsx`, `renderers/complex/carousel.tsx`, `renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `custom/panel-toggles.tsx`, `custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`, the notification surfaces and the tests), so no import path changes.
- One test floor re-measured: `__tests__/empty-description-props-name-the-element-8571.test.tsx` walks every wrapper function under `src/custom/` and floors the population at 12; deleting the item parts leaves 11, so the floor is now 8 (still above the seven-member `Empty` family a broken walk would stop at), with the comment saying why.
- One new changeset, `.changeset/25921-components-helpers-and-family-heads.md`: patch level, `!` title, BREAKING paragraph that separates the 13 deleted names from the 31 off-entry ones, FROM/TO lines for every retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming all 44 operands. No pending `25921-*` changeset is edited.

## Why

Card #25921 narrows `ui/packages` barrels to names someone imports. The checker export list after this PR is exactly the base list minus these 44 (408 to 364), nothing added.

## Tests

Census on `origin/main` b3098661 with the method of batches 1 to 6 (full per-name table with same-module controls: project file `issue-25921-seat6/census-b7.md`): entry names from the TypeScript checker (`getExportsOfModule` on `src/index.ts`, 408); per name `git grep -l -w -F` outside the package minus `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `.changeset/**` (tests and prose count); the package `*.md`, `docs/`, `*.json` minus its CHANGELOG; keep rule 3 by an identifier walk of the built `dist/**/*.d.ts` from every kept export (through local declarations and reached candidates, to fixpoint) plus a source read where the d.ts inlines a type; a TS parse of every tracked source and doc file for named imports from `@object-ui/components` (0 for every retired name); hotcrm `6961ab1` (0 hits for all 44; hotcrm does not import the package, control `Select` 8 files).

| Entry names | Zero outside hits | README-taught | Kept by rule 3 | Kept: released migration names them | Family heads ruled in (homonym hits) | Kept: ADR-0087 gate | Retired |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 408 | 87 | 3 | 41 | 4 (`KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton`, `KanbanSkeletonProps`) | +8 | 3 (`Menubar`, `Carousel`, `CarouselApi`) | 44 |

Controls (outside hits, same module as retired names): `FilterBuilder` 63, `NavigationOverlay` 54, `DataEmptyState` 30, `RelatedCountStore` 37, `NotificationSnackbar` 10, `MobileDialogContent` 5, `Kbd` 4, `ResizablePanel` 5, `ActiveListRecordProvider` 2, `Select` 458, `Command` 215.

Readings at `ecad190f` (branch head; `origin/main` has since moved 5 commits, none touching `ui/packages/components`, and a re-grep of the 44 names there outside the package answers only the six family heads' homonym files the census lists, 0 files for the other 38):

<details><summary>Build, type-check, package tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components...' build` (the package and its dependency closure) on the base: VERDICT command-exit 0; components rebuilt on the final head (`vite build`, declarations rebuilt).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test`: Test Files 477 passed, 1 skipped (478); Tests 4565 passed, 24 skipped (4589); VERDICT command-exit 0. The first run (at da20801b) had 1 red, `empty-description-props-name-the-element-8571.test.tsx` "finds the population" (expected 11 to be ≥ 12), the consequence of deleting the item parts; re-floored in ecad190f, single-file run 7/7 green, then the full run above.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse check over every former entry name</summary>

A temporary probe under `ui/packages/plugin-view/src` importing ALL 408 base entry names of `@object-ui/components` (as `import type`), `tsc --noEmit -p` in `ui/packages/plugin-view` against the rebuilt `dist/index.d.ts`: exactly 44 errors in the probe (`TS2305` 35, `TS2724` 9), and the set of names they name is identical (`diff` empty) to the 44 retired names; the other 364 resolve. The run's 3 other errors are unbuilt sibling packages imported by `ObjectView.tsx` (`plugin-grid`, `plugin-form`, `permissions`), outside the probe. Probe deleted; `git status` clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived families, each run on ecad190f with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock: Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped (172), Tests 4970 passed, 2 skipped; `check:type-check-debt` after dogfood under the lock: OK, 0 raw tsc errors).
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` was red on da20801b: predicate 2 (no-metadata-surface) refused `Menubar` and `Carousel` (Zod describe strings, see Acceptance notes). Both were put back in 76d64842; green since, with all 44 operands verified.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero: all 35 recorded an exit code, none 3).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files in the change set.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (narrowing arm)</summary>

`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock` on ecad190f: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 422 passed, 3 skipped (425); Tests 3527 passed, 41 skipped (3568); no failures.

</details>

No ablation: export lines, deleted declarations nothing read, and one population floor re-measured.

## Acceptance notes

- `Menubar` and `Carousel` stay on the entry, against the first amendment, and `CarouselApi` with them (the `setApi` prop of `Carousel` names it). `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` refuses `runtime-export-retired` for both under predicate 2 (no-metadata-surface): `ui/packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts` carries `.describe('Menubar menus')` and `zod/complex.zod.ts` carries `.describe('Carousel items')`, and the gate deliberately counts a string inside a Zod schema as a reference. Retiring them would need an ADR-0087 ledger entry under `packages/spec`, outside the claim; the seat ruled to keep them (amendment 6674939838) and puts them back on the card's open list.
- `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton` and `KanbanSkeletonProps` have zero readers anywhere, but the released `ViewSkeleton` retirement in `ui/packages/components/CHANGELOG.md` says the other skeletons "stay exported unchanged" and gives them as its FROM/TO targets; the seat ruled them kept.
- `Item` stays: its outside hits are the generic word (346 files, 0 named imports) and cannot be shown hit by hit to be homonyms.
- The previous components changeset in this series (pending in the release PR) lists `MenubarMenu`, `MenubarItem`, `NavigationMenuItem`, `InputOTPGroup`, `InputOTPSeparator` and `CarouselItem` among the names that stay; this changeset says in its body that they leave now. That changeset is not edited (claim rule).

## Verification

Reviewer: `git grep -l -w -e ItemMedia -e NativeSelect -e notificationSeverityStyle -- ':!ui/packages/components' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` answers only this PR's changeset; the CI `Type Check UI` lane compiles every `@object-ui/*` consumer against the narrowed entry.
